headline: Best Monday in two months: $12,055 NP on cheap extra clicks
commentary:
### The day
- **$12,055 NP**, roughly double last Monday, and the margin came with it.
  - NP: $12,055 v $5,672 last Mon
  - NM: 22.1% v 14.1%
- Clears the eight-week Monday high by a street, and tops the fortnight.
  - NP v eight-week Monday mean: $12,055 v $4,141
  - Best previous Monday: $6,402
- Two days into November and we're already ahead of October's pace.
  - MTD NP: $14,789 v $13,016 last month
  - MTD margin: 20.6% v 13.4%
### What drove it
- Volume and lead value moved together, which doesn't happen often.
  - Search clicks: 3,002 v 2,428
  - Search EPL: $29.22 v $26.06
- The extra traffic cost us nothing more per click, so Search margin jumped.
  - Search CPC: $11.83 v $11.79
  - Search NP: $7,915 v $1,516
- generic and bad_credit took most of the extra spend; Bing added on top.
  - generic: $6,688 v $4,841
  - bad_credit: $4,849 v $2,411
  - Bing NP: $2,259 v $1,753
- **Every tree beat its seven-day rate**, so it isn't one fat lead.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $25.16 v $20.07 last7
  - Direct Lenders EPL: $23.93 v $18.37
  - Blended EPL: $18.99 v $15.59 eight-week mean
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 02/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| competitor off SAs | tROAS only, uncapped | $1,096 | $938 | — |
| personal off SAs | tROAS only, uncapped | $200 | $177 | — |
| speed target walk-down | high target, stepping down | $1,243 | $484 | — |
| scavenger pair | tROAS v tCPA, weekends off | $1,452 | $1,150 | — |
- speed spent three times last Monday's, off a very small base.
  - speed clicks: 81 v 30
  - speed CPC: $15.35 v $16.14
- Scavengers hoovered up more cheap clicks, still loose change in the scheme of it.
  - Scavenger clicks: 387 v 323
  - Scavenger CPC: around $3.75 blended
watch: Search EPL at $29.22 sat above the eight-week Monday range, so we're tracking whether it holds nearer $26 over the week.
bad_credit spend doubled to $4,849 while netcredit and uprova added 6.7 and 13.9 points of share, so we're on its EPL.
PMAX fell to $7.67 EPL from $13.89 last Monday on lower spend, and we're following whether that recovers.
